line: Crowley on Atu XVI: the letter Pé, Mars, the destruction of existing material by fire, and the Eye of Horus (pdf p98, p99).

sections.title: Letter, planet and picture
sections.line: Crowley on the letter Pé, the planet Mars and the picture of destruction by fire (pdf p98).

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Pé, which means a mouth; it refers to the planet Mars.
The picture shows the destruction of existing material by fire.

sections.title: Cosmic energy and the Eye of Horus
sections.line: Crowley on the manifestation of cosmic energy in its grossest form (pdf p98) and on the Eye of Horus (pdf p99).

quotes.quote: In its simplest interpretation it refers to the manifestation of cosmic energy in its grossest form.
The dominating feature of this card is the Eye of Horus.
